job.title: Vice President, Communications & Public Affairs
job.description: Global Strategy Group (GSG) is an award-winning public affairs firm working at the intersection of business, politics, and causes. We help our clients build their reputations, tackle big challenges, and win. Our team is comprised of professionals with backgrounds in communications, government, campaigns, journalism, and research. Our culture and values play an integral role in how we operate. We work hard to bring passion, energy, and drive to everything we do. We are looking to hire a motivated, organized, and goal-oriented individual to join our growing Communications & Public Affairs practice. Vice President is a senior-level position that serves as the primary day-to-day client contact and account lead. The ideal candidate brings deep media relations expertise, including a proven track record of pitching and placing stories with national and Beltway outlets, and the ability to lead client engagements from strategy through execution. Vice Presidents are strategic communications experts with demonstrated depth of knowledge and expertise across a variety of industries, often with subject matter expertise in specific sectors. They are active contributors to new business, highly skilled in agency processes, and strong project and people managers.

job.title: Contributions Editor
job.description: The Free Press is growing fast. We need an editor who can respond quickly to news events, craft smart stories, and get the best out of writers. We’re looking for a sharp, creative, and highly organized Contributions Editor to join our editorial team. In this role, you’ll work directly with outside writers—from established voices to first-time contributors—to bring compelling stories, and arguments to life for our audience. You’ll be the bridge between The Free Press and a diverse set of thinkers, ensuring that every piece we publish is distinctive, rigorous, and true to our mission.

job.title: Senior Editor
job.description: The Free Press is growing fast. We need editors who can respond quickly to news events, craft smart stories, and get the best out of staff writers and outside contributors. We’re looking for a sharp, creative, and highly organized Senior Editor to join our editorial team. In this role, you’ll work at the heart of the editorial team working to edit stories from both staff writers and outside contributors on a wide range of topics. You’ll be responsible for running reporters, conceiving and executing high-impact news journalism, and for editing regular columns. You’ll help ensure that The Free Press is publishing distinctive, rigorous, and agenda-setting journalism.
